question: How is the million-liṅga as lord of sacrifice honored?
premises: The deity is addressed as lord of sacrifice
The deity is addressed as million-liṅga
Obeisance is offered to this deity
inference: Obeisance is paid to the million-liṅga, lord of sacrifice.
plain_english: Obeisance to the lord of sacrifice; O million-liṅga, obeisance be to you.
